title: Ajisai Host Protocol
description: The value wire format shared by every host surface. The node is built by one mapping, rust/src/types/value_protocol.rs::value_to_protocol, and its `semantics` bag by one rendering, rust/src/agent/report.rs::semantics_json, which the WASM boundary converts rather than rebuilding (rust/src/wasm_interpreter_bindings/mod.rs::protocol_to_js). Both the CLI/MCP agent surface (the `stack` array inside `ajisai agent compute|check|infer-contracts --json`; the enclosing envelope is documented informally in docs/dev/agent-cli-output-contract.md, non-canonical) and the WASM/GUI boundary (each of AjisaiInterpreter's collect_stack/execute/... methods, with no enclosing envelope of its own) emit arrays of the observedValue node this schema defines. This file is enforced, not only described: tools/mcp-server/sync-assets.js copies its definitions into the MCP result schema (as protocolNode and its neighbours), and the MCP self-test validates every stack the live server returns against them. There is no protocol-version field on this shape today: the CLI envelope around it carries a plain integer `schemaVersion`; the WASM boundary carries no version signal at all. String-valued vocabularies inside `semantics` (a reason, an origin, a diagnosis phase) are left open (no enum) because they are owned by the Rust source and spec/outcomes.json, not duplicated here as a second, narrower list (the cause of a previous, now-corrected drift: see spec/language-semantics.md LANG.OBSERVATION.PROTOCOL).

observedValue.description: One stack value as observed at the host boundary. Every field is derived from the value itself, never from the Word that produced it (LANG.VALUES.DENOTATION). A vector's own elements are observedValue nodes in turn (see `value` below), so this definition is recursive.

type.description: The value's domain (LANG.VALUES.DISJOINT), discriminating `value`'s shape. A NIL is `nil` wherever it stands, including in truth position, where it reads as UNKNOWN (LANG.VALUES.TRUTH).

value.description: Shape depends on `type`: nil -> null; boolean -> boolean; number -> {numerator, denominator} (arbitrary-precision decimal strings, the denominator positive); string or symbol -> string (a symbol's bare name); vector -> an array of observedValue; record -> {keys, values}, two arrays of observedValue of equal length, aligned position by position (LANG.RECORDS.STRUCTURE). null for any type when `elided` is present.

semantics.description: Present on every node except an interior (rank >= 2) tensor node. Every field is optional. Both host surfaces emit the same set, because both render it with one function (rust/src/agent/report.rs::semantics_json).

truthValue.description: Present on a Boolean node, and only there (rust/src/types/value_absence.rs::truth_value). UNKNOWN is a NIL (LANG.VALUES.TRUTH) and is observed through `absence`, not here.

approximate.description: true when the node is an irrational scalar (LANG.VALUES.EXACT), whose `value` is therefore a rational approximation: the best convergent the observation budget affords, or, for a value too large to afford even one, a term-by-term one. `exactTerms` is the value. Never present otherwise.

exactTerms.description: An irrational scalar's exact multiquadratic normal form, structured for computation: one term per {numerator, denominator, radicand}. The stack display writes the same terms as one token (`sqrt(2)`, `1/1+sqrt(2)`).

absence.description: Present only on a nil-type node. `reason` is the stable, machine-readable identifier LANG.VALUES.NIL calls the entire observable content of a NIL (one of spec/outcomes.json's NIL reasons); it is absent only for a NIL an implementation could not yet label. `detail` is the text a `userDeclared` reason carries, which is part of that reason. `origin` and `recoverability` are diagnostic state beyond the reason, informational only: a program cannot observe them, and two NILs with one reason are one value whatever their origin. `diagnosis` nests the structured diagnosis object docs/dev/agent-cli-output-contract.md describes, when the runtime produced one.

exactTerm.description: One term c·√m of the normal form: the rational coefficient numerator/denominator and the square-free radicand m (1 for the rational term).

elided.description: Present only in the stack of a CLI/MCP error report, on a slot whose value was dropped to keep the report deliverable (rust/src/agent/error_stack.rs). `type` and `semantics` still describe what the value was (less an algebraic value's `exactTerms`, whose count moves here); `value` is null. Tell it apart from a genuine NIL by `type`, which names the real domain, and by this field's presence.
